version_policy: no schema or protocol version bump in this slice: the C4.4 protocol (conversation-cognition-proposal-v6 + language-realization-input-v7) is unchanged; only the model-facing rationale/latitude vocabulary changes, and it is bound into this freeze by prompt digest
citation_binding: every factual_assessment.claims[*].source_handles entry must be an advertised F handle and must also appear in cognition.considered_handles AND cognition.evidence_handles; the host binds the citation and refuses the turn otherwise
ref_handles: host-issued, turn-local, deterministic, wire-only handles: F* resolves in FACTUAL SOURCE REFS, C* in the remaining CITEABLE CONTEXT REFS (namespaces disjoint, one handle per ref); unknown, malformed, duplicate or namespace-escalating handles fail closed; canonical refs remain authoritative and are the only refs hashed or stored
rationale_vocabulary: the rationale is a subjective frame (preference/priority/aversion/willingness/strategy) in which a supplied situational fact may be mentioned; it never states or restates a property of the subject
latitude_contract: the latitude determination is a relation between the supplied facts/rules and the available responses, stated fact-relatively ("the supplied facts permit either volunteering or declining"), never as a subject property ("the subject has capacity for either response")
availability_not_capacity: a supplied fact that time or resources are available establishes only that fact; it does not establish capacity, capability, ability, energy, readiness, workload tolerance or any other subject-side condition, and no such mapping may be made
subject_property_terms: capacity, capability, capable, ability, able to, energy, stress, fatigue, bandwidth, readiness, ready to, workload tolerance, resilience — never a rationale, never the subject of a factual claim
